components.name: Primary action
components.description: Shared task action with hover, keyboard focus and pending-disabled styling.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;min-height:48px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:var(--r, 8px);background:var(--brand, #00539d);color:var(--paper, #ffffff);padding:12px 20px;font:700 14px/20px var(--sans, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Nunito Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);}.ds-primary:hover{background:#003f78}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand, #00539d);outline-offset:2px}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:wait;opacity:.6}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: History search field
components.description: Labelled full-width search field with the existing outlined search icon.
components.css: .ds-search{position:relative;display:block;min-width:0;font-family:var(--sans, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Nunito Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-search-label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}.ds-search-icon{pointer-events:none;position:absolute;top:16px;left:12px;color:var(--color-slate-500, oklch(55.4% 0.046 257.417))}.ds-search-input{box-sizing:border-box;min-height:48px;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--color-slate-300, oklch(86.9% 0.022 252.894));border-radius:var(--r, 8px);background:var(--paper, #ffffff);padding:10px 12px 10px 40px;color:var(--navy, #090d46);font:400 16px/24px var(--sans, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Nunito Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif);caret-color:var(--brand, #00539d)}.ds-search-input::placeholder{color:var(--color-slate-500, oklch(55.4% 0.046 257.417))}.ds-search-input:focus{border-color:var(--brand, #00539d);outline:2px solid var(--brand, #00539d);outline-offset:2px}.ds-search-input:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;background:var(--color-slate-50, oklch(98.4% 0.003 247.858));color:var(--color-slate-500, oklch(55.4% 0.046 257.417))}

components.name: Workspace tool navigation
components.description: Dark toolbox surface with default and current tool rows; labels mirror existing navigation.
components.html: Website auditSEO, GEO, links and accessibilitySearch ConsoleIndexing and URL inspection
components.css: .ds-tools{display:grid;gap:6px;padding:20px 16px;background:#071226;color:var(--paper, #ffffff);font-family:var(--sans, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Nunito Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-tool{display:flex;min-height:56px;align-items:center;gap:12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--paper, #ffffff);text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);}.ds-tool-copy{min-width:0;flex:1}.ds-tool-title{display:block;font:800 14px/20px var(--sans, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Nunito Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif);color:var(--paper, #ffffff)}.ds-tool-detail{display:block;margin-top:4px;font:400 12px/20px var(--sans, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Nunito Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif);color:var(--color-slate-300, oklch(86.9% 0.022 252.894))}.ds-tool-external{flex-shrink:0;color:var(--color-slate-300, oklch(86.9% 0.022 252.894))}.ds-tool[aria-current="page"]{border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--color-cyan-200, oklch(91.7% 0.08 205.041)) 40%,transparent);background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--color-cyan-200, oklch(91.7% 0.08 205.041)) 15%,transparent)}.ds-tool:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255 / .1)}.ds-tool:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-cyan-200, oklch(91.7% 0.08 205.041));outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tool{transition:none}}.ds-tool-icon{display:grid;width:36px;height:36px;flex-shrink:0;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .15);border-radius:8px;background:#10213a;color:var(--color-cyan-200, oklch(91.7% 0.08 205.041))}

components.name: Notice chips

components.css: .ds-notices{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font-family:var(--sans, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Nunito Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-notice{display:inline-block;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;background:var(--color-blue-50, oklch(97% 0.014 254.604));color:var(--brand, #00539d);font:700 12px/16px var(--sans, Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Nunito Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif)}.ds-notice-warning{background:var(--color-amber-50, oklch(98.7% 0.022 95.277));color:var(--color-amber-800, oklch(47.3% 0.137 46.201))}

narrative.overview:
The CPA Tools workspace is a compact tools workbench: navy navigation frames white working surfaces, with blue actions and cyan navigation accents. The refinement preserves the incumbent identity and Tailwind implementation rather than introducing a new visual concept.

Hierarchy comes from compact task headings, readable descriptions, single-border panels and explicit control states. The shared shell supports finding a tool and inspecting its evidence without promotional scale or decorative motion. Native disclosures contain secondary configuration, while embedded evidence uses dividers rather than redundant enclosing panels.
keyCharacteristics: Compact task hierarchy with the existing sans-serif stack.
Single-border panels and generous control targets.
Explicit active, pending and unavailable states.

rules.name: The Shell and Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep navy on navigation and white on working content, including the daily-brief gutters.

rules.name: The Compact Heading Rule
rules.body: Use the shared page heading, not the legacy promotional hero ramp, for workspace tool pages.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use single borders for shared working panels; reserve overlay elevation for navigation surfaces.

dos: Do preserve navy navigation, white working surfaces and cyan navigation accents.
Do reuse shared page headings, fields and primary actions through Tailwind utilities.
Do keep evidence, coverage limits and unavailable states visible in plain language.
Do use one border on shared panels and visible offset keyboard outlines on controls.
Do preserve the established sans-serif stack and existing compact type hierarchy.
donts: Don't invent a new identity, display face or promotional hero for the workbench.
Don't turn legacy report CSS, uppercase kickers or tiny report labels into shared design rules.
Don't flatten warning, error and unavailable evidence into a successful state.
Don't use data-specific train colors or operator-local color deviations as workspace brand tokens.
Don't claim report CSS migration or uniformly verified accessibility and reduced-motion coverage.
